display: Built-in Liquid Retina XDR, 3024x1964. Fixed 60 Hertz selected and verified in System Settings for all runs; ProMotion restored afterward.

observations.description: Native scroll container: 24 cards sharing four retained 3072x2048 images, 1200 points/s triangular scrolling; warmup, 5s cached baseline, 30s repeated file decode/mip/upload replacement, drain, 5s cached scrolling. New load at most every 350ms with one pending replacement; old image stays visible until replacement is host-submitted. Same card geometry in all phases. Generated PNGs and OS file cache do not model cold disk. Raw render-start intervals include long gaps and boundary-trigger work, not GPU/presentation/input timing. Keep window foreground at fixed 60 Hz; app has no artificial frame cap. Generation precedes measurement. Pool/resource peaks are sampled, not total process memory.
observations.acceptance_criteria: Provisional 60 Hz check: all three phases p95 <=20ms, <=1% intervals >33.333ms and no >50ms gaps; loading p95 <= baseline p95+2ms; >=30 replacements; >1000 points observed scroll travel; no errors. A failure needs investigation, not sample filtering. Display mode must be independently verified.
